name: Green Field Bell (Thanh Điền Linh)
lore: A small bronze bell tied to the leg of the crane king Thanh Điền, which Ung Hạc Minh tamed in 1197 and which lets no one else ride it (A097). The bell was the founder's; it hung silent in the hall for two hundred years until a crane would wear it.
build_use: The head's crane rite: faster Wind arts, stronger buffs, and the king when it matters.
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Winter Terrace Cloak (Đông Đài Sưởng)
lore: A cloak of crane down quilted between grey felt, made at the winter terrace on Thương Ưng Đài, where the wind never stops and the riders spend the cold months with the flock. Cừ Vân Lý has worn it on every winter flight since 1160.
build_use: A rider's cloak: health, cold resistance and a little speed in the air.
made_by: the felt-makers of Thương Ưng Đài
exception: world-depth signature item: its base's common art or ward until an authored one is ruled (review R6)

name: Robe of Crane Down (Hạc Nhung Bào)
lore: Down gathered from the marsh nests after the young fledge, never plucked; it is warm at the height where riders freeze.
build_use: Evasion and the Wood sustain with it.
